name: playwright-qa-framework
description: Enterprise-grade Playwright E2E test automation framework

scripts.test:allure: playwright test --config=config/playwright.config.js; allure generate allure-results -o allure-report --clean && allure open allure-report
scripts.test:allure:headed: playwright test --config=config/playwright.config.js --headed; allure generate allure-results -o allure-report --clean && allure open allure-report
scripts.test:allure:smoke: playwright test --config=config/playwright.config.js --grep @smoke; allure generate allure-results -o allure-report --clean && allure open allure-report
scripts.test:allure:regression: playwright test --config=config/playwright.config.js --grep @regression; allure generate allure-results -o allure-report --clean && allure open allure-report
scripts.test:allure:e2e: playwright test --config=config/playwright.config.js --grep @e2e; allure generate allure-results -o allure-report --clean && allure open allure-report
scripts.test:allure:negative: playwright test --config=config/playwright.config.js --grep @negative; allure generate allure-results -o allure-report --clean && allure open allure-report
scripts.allure:report: allure generate allure-results -o allure-report --clean && allure open allure-report
scripts.clean: rm -rf test-results playwright-report allure-results allure-report logs/test.log

author: Ashish
